test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is true about the average life expectancy of India?

options.text: Average life expectancy of India is at its all time low
Average life expectancy of India is consistent since centuries now
Average life expectancy of India is consistently rising
Average life expectancy of India is the highest in Asia-Pacific region

solution:
The correct answer is **"Average life expectancy of India is consistently rising."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the third sentence of the first paragraph:
 
 
• *"The average life expectancy has seen a consistent increase since the 1920s and was around 69 years in 2019."*
 
• The average life expectancy in India is the number of years a newborn baby can expect to live.
 
• It has been consistently rising in recent years due to improvements in healthcare, sanitation, and nutrition.
 
 
 
• So, the correct answer is option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Average life expectancy of India is at its all time low"** is incorrect. India's life expectancy has been steadily increasing over the years.
 
• **Option 2: "Average life expectancy of India is consistent since centuries now"** is incorrect. Life expectancy in India has not remained consistent and has been impacted by various factors such as disease, famine, and war.
 
• **Option 4: "Average life expectancy of India is the highest in Asia-Pacific region"** is incorrect. Japan and Singapore have higher life expectancies than India in the Asia-Pacific region.
